Your missionTo support the Group's growth ambitions, EP Power Grit Group is seeking a Product Manager (m/f/d).

The Product Manager is responsible for the strategic development and lifecycle management of the company's product portfolio. The role ensures that customer requirements, market developments, technical capabilities and commercial objectives are translated into competitive products and sustainable growth opportunities.

The responsibilities for this role will be:
Product Portfolio Management
• Own and continuously develop the global product portfolio across blasting abrasives and industrial minerals.
• Manage the complete product lifecycle from product introduction to phase-out.
• Define portfolio priorities and support portfolio simplification.
• Monitor product profitability and recommend portfolio improvements.

Product Development & Innovation
• Identify customer needs and translate them into new product concepts.
• Lead product development projects in collaboration with Operations, Procurement and Quality.
• Support the introduction of sustainable and innovative product solutions.
• Evaluate new raw materials, applications and technologies.

Market & Customer Insights
• Analyze market trends, customer requirements and competitive developments.
• Build structured customer and application knowledge.
• Identify new applications and market opportunities.
• Develop business cases for new products and portfolio extensions.

Commercial Product Management
• Develop compelling product positioning and customer value propositions.
• Support value-based pricing together with Sales.
• Prepare product documentation, technical data sheets and application guides.
• Support strategic customer projects, key tenders and technical presentations.
• Deliver product and application training to Sales teams and distributors.

Cross-functional Collaboration
• Act as the central interface between Sales, Operations, Procurement, Supply Chain and Quality.
• Ensure customer requirements are reflected in product specifications and manufacturing capabilities.
• Coordinate product launches and product changes across all functions.
• Support continuous product improvement initiatives.

Your profile
• 5–10 years of experience in Product Management, Product Development, Portfolio Management or Technical Sales within an industrial B2B environment.
• Experience in abrasives, industrial minerals, construction materials, steel, chemicals or related industries is advantageous.
• Strong understanding of product lifecycle management.
• Commercial mindset combined with technical understanding.
• Experience working closely with Sales and Operations.
• Strong analytical and project management skills.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluent English required; German advantageous.

Why us?"For big ideas with strong partners. Now and in the future." This is our claim, which we stride to fulfil every day anew for our customers in many countries around the world. This commitment shapes your future working environment and creates success together. We are future-oriented, international, and diverse. Your personal and professional development is as important to us, as well as a good work-life balance, a flexible working hours model and an attractive remuneration package.

About usWe are EP Power Grit GmbH based in Oberhausen and specialized in abrasives and industrial minerals based on slags, minerals, glass and other raw materials. The environmentally friendly products are effectively used for surface cleaning in industry, on buildings and ships, for water jet cutting or as decorative building materials. Smart logistics services tailored to customer needs promise additional benefits. With proven production facilities, we produce high-quality abrasives at our sites in Germany and, since December 2022, at additional sites in Belgium, the Netherlands and Finland. We are a subsidiary of EP Power Minerals GmbH and thus part of the Central European energy group Energetický a průmyslový holding (EPH).

Job DescriptionWe are looking for a reliable and highly organized Office & Administration Manager (m/f/d) to support our growing international organization.CS-International GmbH operates in the trading card game, brand marketing, retail, events and entertainment industries. As our business continues to grow, our internal structures and international operations are becoming increasingly complex. We are therefore looking for someone who enjoys creating structure, taking ownership of administrative matters, ensuring that important tasks, documents and deadlines are handled reliably.In this versatile position, you will be a central point of contact for our management team, employees, candidates, service providers and external partners. Your responsibilities will cover general office management, supporting/helping at recruitment and people operations, corporate administration and the coordination of our international entities.Your responsibilities:
• Managing general office administration and day-to-day office organization
• Handling a wide range of administrative and organizational tasks
• Supporting the management team with documents, correspondence, appointments and follow-ups
• Supporting recruitment processes, including communication with applicants and coordination of interviews
• Assisting with onboarding, employee documentatio and other people operations matters
• Communicating with employees, candidates, service providers, tax advisors, payroll providers and public authorities
• Preparing, organizing and maintaining contracts, corporate documents, internal records and other important documentation
• Coordinating administrative matters relating to our international entities
• Researching administrative requirements and procedures in different countries
• Supporting the establishment and administrative setup of additional international entities
• Maintaining corporate information, authorizations, responsibilities, and statutory documentation
• Working closely with the management team and our HR and finance functions
• Helping us continuously improve and document our internal administrative processes

Qualifications
• Completed commercial or business administration training or equivalent professional experience
• A structured, accurate and independent approach to work
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several tasks and deadlines simultaneously
• A proactive mindset and the confidence to follow up on missing information or unresolved matters
• Confident use of Microsoft Office applications
• A professional and dependable manner, combined with a high level of discretion
• Very good written and spoken German
• Good written and spoken English
• Willingness and ability to independently familiarize yourself with new administrative and international topics

Your ProfileAn advantage, but not essential:
• Professional experience in office management, executive assistance, HR administration, or commercial administration
• Knowledge of bookkeeping, preparatory accounting, DATEV, or ERP systems
• A basic understanding of corporate structures, subsidiaries, shareholdings, or holding companies
• Experience working with tax advisors, payroll providers, public authorities, or international service providers

Nice to have:
• Dutch or Japanese language skills
• A valid Class B driving licence

We do not expect you to already have experience in every individual area. What matters most to us is that you work reliably, take responsibility, communicate clearly and are willing to learn. The position offers the opportunity to grow alongside an expanding international company and to gradually take ownership of increasingly important administrative and organizational responsibilities.

About usCS-International GmbH is a fast-growing execution partner operating at the intersection of trading card games, events, retail activation, brands, logistics, organized play, community growth and product development.

We work with partners like Bandai, Wizards of the Coast, Konami, Toei Animation, Grand Archive, Borussia Dortmund and my more, to turn complex ideas into reliable operational delivery. Our team combines deep industry experience with hands-on execution. Flat hierarchies, real ownership, direct communication and the opportunity to contribute to projects that connect brands, players, retailers and communities.

If you want to work in a professional, international and gaming-driven environment where execution matters, we would be happy to hear from you, building, growing and shaping the company together.

We offer at our HQ in Ratingen:
• A diverse and international work environment with a motivated and growing team
• Flat hierarchies, open communication and room to take ownership
• The opportunity to work on international projects across gaming, trading card games, events, retail and logistics
• Regular company gaming events, especially trading card game sessions
• Free water, tea, coffee and soft drinks
• Modern and ergonomic office furniture
• Dog-friendly office environment
• Free parking spots
• Opportunities for personal and professional development

Job DescriptionBuild our warehouse and logistics operations with us!

CS-International is a fast-growing international company operating in the trading card game, collectibles, gaming and entertainment industries.As our business continues to grow, we are building and professionalizing our warehouse and logistics operations in Ratingen. We are therefore looking for a hands-on Junior Warehouse & Logistics Manager who wants to take real ownership, develop scalable processes and grow into a future leadership position.This is not a purely administrative role. You will work directly within the operation, help establish our systems and processes from scratch and gradually take over responsibility for the entire warehouse and logistics function.

Your responsibilities
• Support the setup and continuous development of our warehouse and logistics operations in our brand new warehouse in Ratingen
• Help design efficient processes for inbound goods, storage, picking, packing, shipping and returns
• Actively participate in day-to-day warehouse operations, particularly during the setup phase and peak periods
• Support the implementation and configuration of our new ERP and warehouse management processes
• Translate operational requirements into practical ERP workflows together with management, internal teams and external implementation partners
• Establish clear processes for inventory management, stock accuracy, cycle counts and annual stocktaking
• Help define warehouse layouts, storage locations, product flows and picking structures
• Coordinate parcel and freight shipments as well as relationships with carriers and logistics service providers
• Monitor operational performance and develop relevant KPIs and reports
• Identify bottlenecks, errors and inefficient processes and implement practical improvements
• Create and maintain process documentation, work instructions and operational standards
• Gradually coordinate and lead warehouse employees and temporary staff
• Support logistics planning for events, conventions, retail activities and international projects
• Work closely with Events/Organized Play, Project Management and Management
• Take on increasing responsibility with the long-term perspective of leading our warehouse and logistics department
• Grow gradually into this role, having the opportunity to become part of our management

Qualifications
• Completed vocational training or a degree in logistics, supply chain management, business administration or a comparable field
• Approximately two to three years of relevant professional experience in warehousing, logistics, fulfilment or supply chain operations
• Practical understanding of inbound goods, storage, inventory management, picking, packing, shipping and returns
• Confident use of Microsoft Office applications and general familiarity with digital business systems
• Very good written and spoken German and good written and spoken English (Our main language is ENGLISH!)

Experience with ERP or warehouse management systems, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Shopify, shipping software, international logistics or the coordination of operational teams would be an advantage, but is not essential.

Your Profile
• You have a hands-on mentality and are willing to actively support day-to-day warehouse operations
• You enjoy building new processes, systems and structures rather than simply maintaining established routines
• You work in a structured, accurate and independent manner and take ownership of your responsibilities
• You are able to identify operational problems and develop practical, workable solutions
• You communicate reliably and enjoy working across departments and with external service providers
• You are motivated to support the implementation of a new ERP and warehouse management structure, you are a stakeholder in this process
• You are comfortable working in a growing environment where processes are still being developed
• You have the ambition to gradually take on leadership responsibility and develop into the future head of our warehouse and logistics operations

You do not need to already have experience in every individual area. What matters most to us is your understanding of warehouse operations, your willingness to actively build new structures and your motivation to grow into a responsible leadership position. We want to help you developing with workshops etc. in areas you are not 100% confident.
What to expect
• A key role in building and professionalising our warehouse and logistics operations from the ground up
• The opportunity to actively shape workflows, warehouse structures and operational standards
• Direct involvement in the implementation of our new ERP and warehouse management processes
• A varied position combining hands-on warehouse operations, process development and project work
• A high level of ownership and the freedom to contribute and implement your own ideas
• Close cooperation with management and the opportunity to get involved into the gaming industry
• Short decision-making paths and an international working environment
• Diverse products and projects from the trading card game, collectibles, gaming and entertainment industries
• A growing operation in which responsibilities and leadership opportunities will increase over time
• A clear long-term development perspective towards leading our warehouse and logistics department

You will join us during an important development phase. Not every process is already finalised, and this is exactly where you will make a difference: By helping us create scalable structures that can support the company’s future growth.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join us as an R&D Technology Project Manager (f/m/d) and immerse yourself in the exciting world of large gas turbines! You will lead innovative research and development projects, combining your technical expertise with professional project management skills. Imagine driving initiatives from the initial concept through to software development, validation, and industrial implementation. You will focus on developing cutting-edge software tools and computational methods in aerodynamics, heat transfer, mechanics, and materials science, while coordinating interdisciplinary teams and collaborating with universities and research institutions.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Leadership of complex R&D projects from concept and planning through technical implementation to industrial application
* Management of projects focused on scientific and engineering software tool development
* Coordination of methodology development in aerodynamics, heat transfer, mechanics, and materials science
* Project planning and oversight of schedules, budgets, resources, quality, risks, and deliverables
* Leadership of interdisciplinary international project teams and establishment of long-term research partnerships
* Identification of public funding opportunities, support of proposal preparation, project execution, reporting, and stakeholder communication

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in an engineering or scientific discipline such as Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or Computer Science
* Several years of experience in research and development and managing technically demanding projects, preferably in the energy, turbomachinery, or gas turbine industry
* Understanding of aerodynamics, heat transfer, mechanics, materials science, or scientific software development
* Solid knowledge of project management methodologies, including risk, resource, schedule, and budget management
* Strategic and analytical thinking, leadership capability, and effective communication of complex technical topics to international and interdisciplinary teams
* Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Automation Engineer - Project Execution und Product Development (all genders welcome) (Ingenieur/in - Batterietechnik)
jobs.description:
Unternehmen

thyssenkrupp nucera offers world-leading technologies for high-efficiency electrolysis plants. The company has extensive in-depth knowledge in the engineering, procurement, and construction of electrochemical plants and a strong track record of more than 600 projects with a total rating of over 10 gigawatts already successfully installed. With its water electrolysis technology to produce green hydrogen, the company offers an innovative solution on an industrial scale for green value chains and an industry fueled by clean energy – a major step towards a climate-neutrality.
www.thyssenkrupp-nucera.com

Aufgaben

You will be part of our global Automation organization and play a key role in the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of automation standards for electrolysis projects, including green hydrogen (AWE), chlor-alkali and HCl electrolysis technologies.
Your role involves assuming responsibility for defined engineering work packages to support parallel project execution and enhance delivery reliability and throughput as well as responsibility for complete automation scopes during various phases of project execution.
Your tasks:

- Acting as a technical lead for automation topics within projects executed by our global automation team
- Performing basic and detail engineering for control and safety systems, including architecture design, hardware planning and software concepts
- Supporting technical procurement, supplier clarification and evaluation of automation components and systems
- Preparing and supporting Factory Acceptance Tests, including coordination with suppliers and alignment within our global automation team
- Providing support for installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities for automation systems at construction sites worldwide, primarily through short-term assignments (remote and on-site, as required)
- Serving as a key technical interface within our global automation organization and other global stakeholders
- Ensuring compliance with internal standards, project-specific requirements, functional safety and IT/OT security guidelines
- Creating and reviewing technical documentation using database-based and engineering IT tools
- Actively sharing knowledge and best practices and mentoring junior engineers
- Contributing to the continuous improvement of our automation solutions
- Contribute to the development, maintenance and evolution of standardized automation solutions
- Drive modularization, reusability and productization of automation assets to support scalable and future-proof solutions

Profil

- Degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering or comparable technical discipline
- Several years of professional experience in automation engineering for industrial or process plants, preferably in chemical or electrolysis plant engineering
- Strong hands-on experience with industrial automation systems and hardware, including SAS and PLC platforms from leading manufacturers
- Strong understanding of automation system architectures
- Interest or experience in new automation technologies, digitalization, simulation or advanced engineering methods is an advantage
- Solid knowledge of network and fieldbus technologies (e.g. Profinet, Modbus TCP)
- Experience or strong understanding of functional safety and IT/OT security concepts in industrial environments
- Ability to work independently and structured, with a strong sense of ownership for technical results and quality
- Proven capability to work in international and intercultural teams
- Very good English und German communication skills, both written and verbal (min. C1)
- Willingness to travel internationally for short-term assignments
- Natural inclination to coach and support less experienced colleagues, acting as a role model within the team

Das bieten wir

As part of the thyssenkrupp group, we offer our employees high level conditions and many benefits:

- performance-related compensation according to collective agreement Metal und Electro NRW
- attractive old-age provision models
- groupwide learning measures
- thyssenkrupp Group health campaigns and programs
At thyssenkrupp nucera, we attach great importance to individual needs - to this end, we are constantly developing as an employer and offer a wide range of benefits for your perfect working-life-balance:
- In an environment characterized by flat hierarchies and a lot of personal responsibility, we create space for individual development.
- We offer further training and support in line with your individual strengths and goals in order to optimally accompany your career path.
- In intercultural and interdisciplinary teams, communication at eye level is our top priority.
- Flexitime, part-time, home office, mobile working abroad: whenever possible, we give you the flexibility you want for your work.
- For the perfect office days, we provide state-of-the-art equipment at our global locations as well as quiet and communal areas for every situation.
- For a potential move to a location near the office, we will support your relocation organizationally and financially - also internationally.
- Your personal business buddy will be at your side during your induction - so new starters quickly get to know the company, the department and their colleagues.
- If that's not enough for you: by working on green hydrogen technologies, we are ensuring clean energy for the future. Be a part of it: new era is you.

Thomas Worobjew
People Attraction and Acquisition Expert
nca-de-recruiting@thyssenkrupp-nucera.com
